sentences.en: And your message is that if you're angry, if you're scared in this moment, we're the place for you.
sentences.zh: 你传达的信息是，如果你在这个时刻感到愤怒、感到害怕，我们就是你的归宿。

sentences.en: We're the place for you.
sentences.zh: 我们就是你的归宿。

sentences.en: And we can fight this together.
sentences.zh: 我们可以一起战斗。

sentences.en: And then the moment that we could make good on that promise was the Muslim ban weekend.
sentences.zh: 而我们能够兑现这一承诺的时刻，就是穆斯林禁令生效的那个周末。

sentences.en: That night, we file in court.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我们在法庭上提起诉讼。

sentences.en: You know, within hours of him signing the executive order, we have filed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在他签署行政命令后的几个小时内，我们就已经提起诉讼了。

sentences.en: And then we are in court on an emergency hearing, getting the first national stay on the Muslim ban.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在紧急听证会上出庭，获得了针对穆斯林禁令的全国第一个暂缓令。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And we're walking out of the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 而我们正走出法庭。

sentences.en: It's a Cadman Plaza in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 那是布鲁克林的卡德曼广场。

sentences.en: And, you know, out of nowhere, when I come out of the court hearing, there are several thousand people who have just spontaneously convened.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，出乎意料的是，当我走出听证会时，有几千人自发地聚集在那里。

sentences.en: What we've shown today is that the courts can work.
sentences.zh: 我们今天展示的是，法院是可以发挥作用的。

sentences.en: I was kind of stunned.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点震惊。

sentences.en: And when President Trump enacts laws or executive orders that are unconstitutional and illegal, the courts are there to defend everyone's rights.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统颁布违宪和非法的法律或行政命令时，法院就在那里捍卫每个人的权利。

sentences.en: So we want to thank you very, very much.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: I've walked out of a lot of courtrooms, but not on a Saturday night in the middle of a January winter evening,
sentences.zh: 我走出过很多法庭，但从没有在1月冬夜的一个周六晚上

sentences.en: and finding thousands of people braving the cold, chanting, you know, ACLU, we are here, we stand with you.
sentences.zh: 看到成千上万的人冒着严寒，高喊着，你知道，美国公民自由联盟，我们在这里，我们与你们站在一起。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, my God, this is different.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，天哪，这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: This is different.
sentences.zh: 这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: And in that 24, 28-hour period, there were 4,100 new members per minute on the website.
sentences.zh: 在那个24、28小时内，网站每分钟有4100个新会员加入。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that's when we knew this was different.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们知道这不一样了。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, my God, we've tapped into something.
sentences.zh: 我想，天哪，我们触及到核心了。

sentences.en: People are worked up.
sentences.zh: 人们的情绪被调动起来了。

sentences.en: They are angry.
sentences.zh: 他们很愤怒。

sentences.en: They are motivated.
sentences.zh: 他们很有动力。

sentences.en: They want to know, what can we do?
sentences.zh: 他们想知道，我们能做些什么？

sentences.en: So we had to develop this whole people power platform.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须开发这个全民力量平台。

sentences.en: So, for instance, one of the first things we had the people power activists do was to kind of double down on enacting sanctuary city laws across the country.
sentences.zh: 因此，举例来说，我们让全民力量活动人士做的第一件事之一，就是在全国范围内加倍努力制定庇护城市法律。

sentences.en: So rather than just play defense, which we're doing in terms of helping some litigation against the sanctuary city jurisdictions, we said, let's go on offense.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们不仅仅是采取守势——我们在帮助对庇护城市管辖区的一些诉讼方面正在这样做，我们说，我们要转入攻势。

sentences.en: Let's try to enact more sanctuary city jurisdictions.
sentences.zh: 让我们努力建立更多的庇护城市管辖区。

sentences.en: What we've got is not good enough.
sentences.zh: 我们得到的还不够好。

sentences.en: So create new sanctuary cities.
sentences.zh: 所以要创建新的庇护城市。

sentences.en: Create new sanctuary city jurisdictions.
sentences.zh: 创建新的庇护城市管辖区。

sentences.en: And we enacted more than 21 new sanctuary city laws across the country.
sentences.zh: 我们在全国各地颁布了21项以上新的庇护城市法律。

sentences.en: One of them in a place like Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 其中一个在像菲尼克斯这样地方。

sentences.en: Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的菲尼克斯。

sentences.en: Big city.
sentences.zh: 大城市。

sentences.en: And a big red state.
sentences.zh: 一个坚定的红州。

sentences.en: And a border state.
sentences.zh: 一个边境州。

sentences.en: And a border state.
sentences.zh: 一个边境州。

sentences.en: And we put people to work and we sent them out.
sentences.zh: 我们让人投入工作，并把他们派了出去。

sentences.en: And they were people who were just school teachers and massage therapists and ordinary folk who went to meet with their local elected officials and said,
sentences.zh: 他们只是学校老师、按摩师和普通百姓，他们去会见当地民选官员，并说

sentences.en: this is why we need a sanctuary city jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们需要庇护城市管辖权的原因。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what we want to do more of, is to use the pincer of litigation, assume in court, and then mobilize the public, play offense, and play defense.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们想要做更多的事情，就是利用诉讼的钳形攻势，在法庭上起诉，然后动员公众，打进攻，也打防守。

sentences.en: So you're now talking about passing new legislation and engaging voters to marshal around causes.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在在谈论通过新的立法并吸引选民围绕事业团结起来。

sentences.en: So I want to pose a theory to you.
sentences.zh: 所以我想向你提出一个理论。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Having just had the Supreme Court uphold the travel ban, which was a real loss for you,
sentences.zh: 刚刚最高法院维持了旅行禁令，这对你来说是一个真正的损失，

sentences.en: and with the Supreme Court now the most conservative we've seen it in basically our lifetimes,
sentences.zh: 而且现在的最高法院是我们记忆中最保守的一届，

sentences.en: is part of this shift about not being able to have confidence that the court will work in your favor.
sentences.zh: 这种转变的一部分是否是因为对法院能对你有利不抱有信心。

sentences.en: You know, I think you can't put all your eggs in the judicial basket.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为你不能把所有的鸡蛋都放在司法篮子里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I still think that there are ways to file important civil liberties and civil rights cases that will convince conservative judges and conservative justices in the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我仍然认为有办法提起重要的公民自由和民权案件，这些案件将说服最高法院的保守派法官和保守派大法官。

sentences.en: I mean, like, look at the family separation issue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看看家庭分离问题。

sentences.en: The American Civil Liberties Union is suing the Trump administration over forced separations of asylum-seeking families.
sentences.zh: 美国公民自由联盟正在起诉特朗普政府强行分离寻求庇护的家庭。

sentences.en: We drew a Republican-appointed judge.
sentences.zh: 我们抽到了一位共和党任命的法官。

sentences.en: A federal judge in California ruled overnight.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州的一名联邦法官连夜做出裁决。

sentences.en: And it was great.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: That the Trump administration must reunite separated immigrant families within 30 days.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府必须在30天内让失散的移民家庭团聚。

sentences.en: That he was a Republican George Bush appointee.
sentences.zh: 他是由共和党乔治·布什任命的。

sentences.en: Because ultimately, it became harder for people to dismiss his ruling when he mandated the fact that these 3,000 families had to be reunited.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，当他下令这3000个家庭必须团聚时，人们很难驳回他的裁决。

sentences.en: And it is really putting the government through its paces to ensure that they reunite the kids with the parents.
sentences.zh: 这确实是在督促政府确保他们让孩子与父母团聚。

sentences.en: It's fantastic that people cannot just write it off as just another kind of latte-sipping, Bruno Mogli-wearing, liberal judge on the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，人们不能把它仅仅归结为海岸边另一个啜饮拿铁、穿着布鲁诺·莫格利的自由派法官。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that litigation is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 因此诉讼仍在继续。

sentences.en: But part of it is also to kind of shape the public debate on this issue.
sentences.zh: 但其中一部分也是为了塑造公众对这个问题的辩论。

sentences.en: So we've run TV spots.
sentences.zh: 所以我们播放了电视广告。

sentences.en: It all started when Donald Trump tore thousands of immigrant children away from their parents.
sentences.zh: 这一切都始于唐纳德·特朗普将数千名移民儿童从父母身边夺走。

sentences.en: We, the people, challenged him in court and in the streets.
sentences.zh: 我们，人民，在法庭上和街道上向他发起挑战。

sentences.en: We had a big day of action in Brownsville.
sentences.zh: 我们在布朗斯维尔举行了盛大的行动日。

sentences.en: Hello, this is John Legend.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是约翰·传奇。

sentences.en: I'm standing with the ACLU.
sentences.zh: 我与美国公民自由联盟站在一起。

sentences.en: We've had celebrities.
sentences.zh: 我们有名人支持。

sentences.en: Hey, America.
sentences.zh: 嘿，美国。

sentences.en: Hey, America.
sentences.zh: 嘿，美国。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Things are crazy right now.
sentences.zh: 现在事情太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Talk to their constituents about why this matters.
sentences.zh: 与他们的选民谈论为什么这很重要。

sentences.en: We're all overwhelmed, but listen.
sentences.zh: 我们都不堪重负，但听着。

sentences.en: The ACLU is on it.
sentences.zh: 美国公民自由联盟正在处理此事。

sentences.en: The ACLU has had your back for almost 100 years.
sentences.zh: 美国公民自由联盟近100年来一直是您的后盾。

sentences.en: So effectively, the ACLU is becoming as much a political organization as it is one, it sounds, about litigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，实际上，美国公民自由联盟正在成为一个政治组织，听起来就像一个关于诉讼的组织。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: With your help, we got this.
sentences.zh: 在您的帮助下，我们一定能行。

sentences.en: We got this.
sentences.zh: 我们一定能行。

sentences.en: We got this.
sentences.zh: 我们一定能行。

sentences.en: But is there a concern right away with this messaging that you're doing and the strength of people's divisions that have been revealed in this election?
sentences.zh: 但在这场选举中，您所做的这种信息传递以及人们分歧的强度，是否会立刻引起人们的担忧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That you're starting to tap into a partisan dynamic.
sentences.zh: 你开始触及党派活力。

sentences.en: And perhaps inevitably, that you're seeming to pick a side.
sentences.zh: 也许不可避免地，你似乎在选择立场。

sentences.en: You know, we're fighting this president not because he's a Republican.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们与这位总统斗争不是因为他是共和党人。

sentences.en: We're fighting this president because of the challenges he represents on civil liberties and civil rights.
sentences.zh: 我们与这位总统斗争是因为他在公民自由和民权方面带来的挑战。

sentences.en: And we have earned our nonpartisan stripes over 100 years, right?
sentences.zh: 我们在100年的时间里赢得了我们的非党派条纹，对吧？

sentences.en: We fought FDr.
sentences.zh: 我们与罗斯福斗争过。

sentences.en: We fought Clinton.
sentences.zh: 我们与克林顿斗争过。

sentences.en: We fought Obama, right?
sentences.zh: 我们与奥巴马斗争过，对吧？

sentences.en: Probably the most contentious meeting I've ever had has been with President Obama.
sentences.zh: 我开过的最具争议的会议可能就是与奥巴马总统的会议了。

sentences.en: Sometimes our values, I mean, to give you one example of where it's important to lead in a challenging moment.
sentences.zh: 有时我们的价值观，我的意思是，举一个在充满挑战的时刻发挥领导作用的重要性的例子。

sentences.en: A year ago, when we decided to provide legal representation to the Nazis and Stephen Kessler in Charlottesville.
sentences.zh: 一年前，当我们决定为夏洛茨维尔的纳粹分子和斯蒂芬·凯斯勒提供法律代理时。

sentences.en: If it hadn't been for the legal assistance they received from the American Civil Liberties Union,
sentences.zh: 如果没有美国公民自由联盟提供的法律援助，

sentences.en: the white supremacists who led the ill-fated march in Charlottesville would likely have been forced to accept a venue far removed from the statue of Robert E.
sentences.zh: 在夏洛茨维尔领导这场注定失败的游行的白人至上主义者很可能会被迫接受一个远离罗伯特·E·李雕像的场地

sentences.en: Lee that was at issue.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时的问题所在。

sentences.en: And we said that is not the government's role to decide who gets a permit based on the content of their speech or the content of their message.
sentences.zh: 我们说过，根据言论内容或信息内容来决定谁获得许可证，这不是政府的角色。

sentences.en: We were unfortunately sued by the ACLU and the judge ruled against us.
sentences.zh: 我们不幸被美国公民自由联盟起诉，法官作出了对我们不利的裁决。

sentences.en: We got lots of criticism, internally and externally.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多批评，来自内部和外部。

sentences.en: And I think that's a moment when you burnish the nonpartisan credential and you say, when we believe these rights are for everyone, we truly mean it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个你擦亮无党派信誉的时刻，你说，当我们相信这些权利属于每个人时，我们是真心实意的。

sentences.en: And even for people we hate and whose ideology is loathsome and disgusting and hurtful.
sentences.zh: 甚至是针对我们讨厌的人，他们的意识形态令人厌恶、恶心和伤人。

sentences.en: You know, if we were just a liberal left advocacy group, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们只是一个自由派左翼倡导组织，你知道，

sentences.en: no other liberal left advocacy group in the Bernie Sanders wing of the Democratic Party would take on those types of cases and clients.
sentences.zh: 民主党伯尼·桑德斯派系中没有其他自由派左翼倡导组织会承担这类案件和客户。

sentences.en: I think it's really important for us to kind of continue to forge a path that talks about this being about the rights of everyone.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我们来说非常重要的一点是，继续开辟一条道路，讨论这是关于每个人的权利。

sentences.en: But would you say that the shift in tactics that you're describing is in direct response to President Trump?
sentences.zh: 但你会说你所描述的战术转变是对特朗普总统的直接回应吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And as you make this change in tactics, do you look to other groups like the NRA for a model of how to do it effectively?
sentences.zh: 当你们改变战术时，你们会向全国步枪协会（NRA）等其他组织寻求如何有效做到这一点的典范吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So back in 2013, I'd have to pull it.
sentences.zh: 早在2013年，我得查一下。

sentences.en: I think the NRA and the ACLU were of comparable size.
sentences.zh: 我认为NRA和ACLU的规模相当。

sentences.en: But if you had asked me, you know, who had had a greater impact on American society and politics and government in 2013, I'd have to say it was the NRA.
sentences.zh: 但如果你问我，你知道，在2013年谁对美国社会、政治和政府产生了更大的影响，我必须说是NRA。

sentences.en: So I was trying to understand, well, why is it that they punch so much above their weight if they're the same size as we are?
sentences.zh: 所以我想了解，如果他们和我们规模一样，为什么他们的影响力远远超出他们的体量？

sentences.en: And I actually spent a bunch of time looking at their website.
sentences.zh: 我实际上花了很多时间浏览他们的网站。

sentences.en: And their website was very different than our website.
sentences.zh: 他们的网站和我们的网站非常不同。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: It was much more narrative.
sentences.zh: 它更有叙事性。

sentences.en: My dad was a hunter, a big-time clayo hunter, and also a squirrel hunter.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸是个猎人，是个飞碟射击猎人，也是个松鼠猎人。

sentences.en: There were stories.
sentences.zh: 那里有故事。

sentences.en: There were videos.
sentences.zh: 那里有视频。

sentences.en: I got a gun when I was four, and my parents shot with me.
sentences.zh: 我四岁时就得到了一把枪，我父母和我一起射击。

sentences.en: And I remember it's a little .22 that my dad actually had to customize for me.
sentences.zh: 我记得这是一把小22口径手枪，我爸爸实际上不得不为我定制。

sentences.en: He shortened the stock, and he shortened the barrel.
sentences.zh: 他缩短了枪托，缩短了枪管。

sentences.en: You know, the daughter being shown how to hunt with her father and what that meant to her.
sentences.zh: 你知道，女儿被展示如何与父亲一起打猎以及这对她意味着什么。

sentences.en: And now my daughter and my son are both shooting that gun.
sentences.zh: 现在我的女儿和儿子都在用那把枪射击。

sentences.en: There were wine clubs, discounts for your automobile insurance through the NRA.
sentences.zh: 那里有葡萄酒俱乐部，通过NRA购买汽车保险的折扣。

sentences.en: It was just—it was—
sentences.zh: 它只是——它——

sentences.en: Kind of all-encompassing.
sentences.zh: 可以说是包罗万象的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was a lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 这是一种生活方式。

sentences.en: I wanted to understand from their playbook, what could I learn from their playbook that we could adopt here?
sentences.zh: 我想从他们的剧本中了解，我可以从他们的剧本中学习什么，我们可以在这里采用什么？

sentences.en: I think the thing I learned most from a report that we commissioned in 2013 is that when you look at the way they talk about their mandate, the Second Amendment,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们从2013年委托的一份报告中学到的最多的一点是，当你看到他们谈论他们的授权、宪法第二修正案的方式时，

sentences.en: they don't talk about it in legalistic or policy wonk terMs.
sentences.zh: 他们不是用法律主义或政策行话来谈论它的。

sentences.en: They talk about the gun culture, right?
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的是枪支文化，对吧？

sentences.en: They talk about it in very personal—
sentences.zh: 他们以非常个人的方式——

sentences.en: Lifestyle terMs.
sentences.zh: 生活方式术语。

sentences.en: Lifestyle terMs.
sentences.zh: 生活方式术语。

sentences.en: And that was when the light bulb went off in our heads.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们脑子里的灯泡亮了。

sentences.en: It was just like, oh, my God, we can definitely do that, too.
sentences.zh: 就像，天哪，我们肯定也能做到这一点。

sentences.en: And we're talking about—because when we're talking about liberty, we're not talking about the First or the Fourth or the Fifth Amendment.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论——因为当我们谈论自由时，我们不是在谈论第一、第四或第五修正案。

sentences.en: We are, but we're not only talking about that.
sentences.zh: 我们是的，但我们不仅在谈论这个。

sentences.en: We're talking about the ability for an individual to live the life she wishes to have with the dignity she's entitled to in our democracy.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论个人在我们的民主制度中以她应得的尊严过她希望过的生活的能力。

sentences.en: And so people really experience their freedom, their autonomy, their agency,
sentences.zh: 所以人们真正以非常深刻的个人方式体验他们的自由、他们的自主权、他们的能动性、

sentences.en: their self-actualization in deeply personal ways that they may not understand what the language of the Fourth or the Fifth Amendment is, and it doesn't really matter, right?
sentences.zh: 他们的自我实现，他们可能不理解第四或第五修正案的语言是什么，这其实并不重要，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I use the metaphor always like, you know, if you're shipping off your Christmas presents, let's say, in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我总是用这个比喻，你知道，如果你在美国邮政局寄圣诞礼物，比方说，

sentences.en: Postal Office, and you're standing on that long queue to send mom her gift, and someone tries to cut in front of you on that long line, watch how people respond, right?
sentences.zh: 你正站在长长的队伍里把礼物寄给妈妈，而有人试图在那条长长的队伍里插队，看看人们是如何反应的，对吧？

sentences.en: That ain't fair.
sentences.zh: 这不公平。

sentences.en: That ain't right, right?
sentences.zh: 这不对，对吧？

sentences.en: There is something innately visceral about saying, that just ain't right.
sentences.zh: 有一种发自内心的直觉说，这根本不对。

sentences.en: That kind of gut, that kind of instinctual reaction to an injustice,
sentences.zh: 这种直觉，这种对不公正的本能反应，

sentences.en: if we can find a way to kind of tap into that and to get people to understand that what we're talking about here is about leveling the playing field
sentences.zh: 如果我们能找到一种方法来利用这一点，让人们明白我们在这里谈论的是平整竞技场

sentences.en: and about making sure that you have the right to live the life you choose to have.
sentences.zh: 并确保你有权过你选择的生活。

sentences.en: So you want to build a lifestyle, essentially, around people's sense of righteousness and civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 所以，从本质上讲，你是想围绕人们的正义感和公民自由感来构建一种生活方式。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The way that the NRA has done it with the right to bear arMs.
sentences.zh: 就像美国步枪协会（NRA）利用持枪权所做的那样。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And look what we've done with the kids separated from their parents.
sentences.zh: 看看我们在骨肉分离的儿童事件上做了什么。

sentences.en: You know, we didn't have to get into the kind of due process, equal protection arguments.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们本不必陷入那种正当程序、平等保护的争论中。

sentences.en: I mean, we did for the judge, but that isn't the way that we framed the public debate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为了法官我们确实这么做了，但这不是我们塑造公众辩论的方式。

sentences.en: It wasn't a good Fifth Amendment argument that got people's outcry, saying, oh, my God, that's a great Fifth Amendment argument.
sentences.zh: 并不是一个出色的第五修正案论点引发了人们的抗议，让人觉得，哦，天哪，这是一个绝妙的第五修正案论点。

sentences.en: Let me go to a proteSt.
sentences.zh: 让我去参加抗议吧。

sentences.en: No, it's the basic idea that, oh, my God,
sentences.zh: 不，最根本的想法是，哦，天哪，

sentences.en: you separated these toddlers from their mothers and you lost them in the system and you deported their parents into a different country while you're holding on to their kids.
sentences.zh: 你们把这些幼儿从母亲身边夺走，让他们在体制中失踪，在扣留他们孩子的同时把他们的父母驱逐到另一个国家。

sentences.en: Are you kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: You know, that type of response and that type of gut, cultural, instinctual kind of reaction, that is just wrong, just plain wrong.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种回应以及那种发自内心的、文化的、本能的反应，这是不对的，完全是不对的。

sentences.en: But the NRA has a really distinct advantage of being built around one constitutional right, the Second Amendment.
sentences.zh: 但美国步枪协会有一个非常独特的优势，那就是它建立在一个宪法权利之上，即第二修正案。

sentences.en: So the lifestyle stuff that you're describing all feels like an extension of that.
sentences.zh: 所以你所描述的生活方式，感觉就像是这种权利的延伸。

sentences.en: So it does seem harder when, as you say, people don't quite understand the amendments that you're working with.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如你所说，当人们并不完全理解你所依据的修正案时，事情似乎就更艰难了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they span the partisan gamut.
sentences.zh: 而且它们跨越了党派的各个阶层。

sentences.en: Is there a risk that you're just building a lifestyle really around disliking Trump?
sentences.zh: 是否存在这样一种风险，即你们构建的生活方式实际上只是围绕着讨厌特朗普？

sentences.en: No, because ultimately you've got to be able to talk about what it is you're fighting for, right?
sentences.zh: 不，因为归根结底，你必须能够谈论你所争取的是什么，对吧？

sentences.en: What is it you're trying to accomplish?
sentences.zh: 你到底想实现什么？

sentences.en: I think what is important to underscore is that, look, is the ACLU fighting Donald Trump and his policies with all the vigor that we can muster?
sentences.zh: 我认为需要强调的是，美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）难道不是在用我们所能汇聚的所有力量来反对唐纳德·特朗普及其政策吗？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 当然是。

sentences.en: Is it because he's a Republican?
sentences.zh: 这是因为他是共和党人吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Is it because of the policies and priorities of his administration?
sentences.zh: 是因为他政府的政策和优先事项吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Does that mean that we, you know,
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着我们，你知道的，

sentences.en: give a pass to Democrats or that we're going to be less vigilant or less assertive if it's a different Republican president or even a different Democratic president?
sentences.zh: 会对民主党人网开一面，或者如果是另一个不同的共和党总统，甚至是不同的民主党总统，我们会减少警惕或不够坚定？

sentences.en: You know, hell no.
sentences.zh: 你知道，绝不可能。

sentences.en: I think it would be a real abdication of responsibility if we didn't fight this administration with everything we've got because we're worried that people will conceive of us as partisan.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果我们因为担心被认为有党派倾向，而不竭尽全力与本届政府作斗争，那将是对责任的真正放弃。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is that you believe you're fighting for everyone, even if they themselves don't see it that way.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，你相信你在为每个人战斗，即使他们自己并不这么认为。

sentences.en: What do you say to a Trump voter who says, OK, but you are literally, ACLU, declaring war with my president.
sentences.zh: 你对一个特朗普选民会说些什么？他们会说，好吧，但美国公民自由联盟，你简直是在向我的总统宣战。

sentences.en: So how are you really for me?
sentences.zh: 所以你究竟是怎么为了我的？

sentences.en: I'm declaring war on some of the policies of your president that are fundamentally un-American and that your president and his success and his role in the country will benefit by my holding his feet to the fire.
sentences.zh: 我是在向你总统的一些从根本上不符合美国价值观的政策宣战，而且通过我逼迫他兑现承诺，你的总统、他的成功以及他在国家中的角色都将从中受益。

sentences.en: All I am is I make the workings of our democratic system stronger.
sentences.zh: 我所做的只是让我们的民主制度运转得更加强有力。

sentences.en: I file a lawsuit on behalf of clients that has to go before a judge.
sentences.zh: 我代表客户提起诉讼，这必须由法官裁决。

sentences.en: I make my best political arguments and lobbying and mobilizing the public put pressure on elected officials.
sentences.zh: 我提出最好的政治论点、进行游说并动员公众向民选官员施压。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, it is a judge who decides the legality or the unconstitutionality of an action and the propriety of our lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，是由法官来决定一项行动的合法性或违宪性以及我们诉讼的正当性。

sentences.en: And it is a legislator or an elected official who's going to decide the policy.
sentences.zh: 是由立法者或民选官员来决定政策。

sentences.en: So even if you say that 90 percent of our positions are wrong, I make the democratic process more robust and more energetic.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使你说我们90%的立场是错的，我也让民主进程变得更加强健和充满活力。

sentences.en: And I serve as a countervailing force ensuring that there's proper checks and balances on the executive and legislative branches by my being engaged directly.
sentences.zh: 通过直接参与，我充当了一种制衡力量，确保对行政和立法分支进行适当的检查和平衡。

sentences.en: And there, I think you want me.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我想你需要我。

sentences.en: You know, I think we can't afford to just write off everyone who voted for this president as being our enemy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为我们不能简单地把投这位总统票的所有人都当成我们的敌人。

sentences.en: I tend to be an optimiSt.
sentences.zh: 我往往是个乐观主义者。

sentences.en: I think it's very hard to find, you know, even some staunch supporters of this president of good faith and good mind who will, in a moment of quiet, say,
sentences.zh: 我认为很难找到——你知道，甚至这位总统的一些真诚且思想健康的坚定支持者——在某个安静的时刻会说，

sentences.en: I voted for this president and I think it's great that we're separating kids from their families.
sentences.zh: 我投票给这位总统，我觉得把孩子和家庭拆散真是太棒了。

sentences.en: And I think they'll just have moments when they'll they'll they'll they'll pause and they'll ask the hard questions.
sentences.zh: 我想他们总会有那么一些时刻，会停下来，提出一些艰难的问题。

sentences.en: Well, Anthony, I really want to thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，安东尼，我真的很感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You bet.
sentences.zh: 不用谢。

sentences.en: You bet, Michael.
sentences.zh: 不用谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Joel Lovell, who first wrote about the ACLU's changing tactics for The New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢乔尔·洛维尔，他首次为《纽约时报杂志》撰文报道了美国公民自由联盟不断变化的策略。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 解锁《纽约时报》应用程序。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Let me ask you about this.
sentences.zh: 让我问你这个。

sentences.en: President Trump just tweeted saying, I would be willing to shut down the government if the Democrats do not give us the votes for border security, which includes the wall.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统刚刚发推文说，如果民主党人不给我们提供用于边境安全的选票，包括修建隔离墙，我愿意让政府关门。

sentences.en: Must get rid of lottery catch and release, etc., and finally go to system of immigration based on merit.
sentences.zh: 必须废除抽签、抓了就放等制度，最终转向基于择优的移民制度。

sentences.en: In a tweet on Sunday, President Trump threatened to shut down the federal government this fall if Congress does not pass sweeping immigration reform,
sentences.zh: 在周日的一条推文中，特朗普总统威胁说，如果国会不通过全面的移民改革，

sentences.en: including more funding for his proposed border wall.
sentences.zh: 包括为他提议的边境墙提供更多资金，他将在今年秋天让联邦政府关门。

sentences.en: But such a shutdown could endanger Republicans seeking re-election this November, prompting Ohio Representative Steve Stivers,
sentences.zh: 但这样的关门可能会危及今年11月谋求连任的共和党人，这促使俄亥俄州众议员史蒂夫·斯蒂弗斯（Steve Stivers）——

sentences.en: who is coordinating Republican congressional campaigns, to dismiss Trump's idea during an interview with ABC's This Week.
sentences.zh: 他负责协调共和党国会竞选——在接受美国广播公司（ABC）《本周》节目采访时对特朗普的想法不予理睬。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think we're going to shut down the government, you know, I think we're going to make sure we keep the government open,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们不会让政府关门，你知道，我认为我们会确保政府继续运转，

sentences.en: but we're going to get better policies on immigration.
sentences.zh: 但我们将制定更好的移民政策。

sentences.en: And on Sunday, President Trump disclosed a recent off-the-record meeting with the publisher of The Times, A.G.
sentences.zh: 而在周日，特朗普总统透露了最近与《时报》出版商A.G.·苏兹伯格（A.G. Sulzberger）的一次闭门会议，

sentences.en: Sulzberger, during which he said the two had discussed, quote,
sentences.zh: 他表示两人在会上讨论了，引述：

sentences.en: the vast amount of fake news being put out by the media, and how the fake news has morphed into the phrase enemy of the people.
sentences.zh: 媒体发布的巨量假新闻，以及假新闻是如何演变成人民的敌人这一说法的。

sentences.en: But in response, Sulzberger said the president had mischaracterized the meeting.
sentences.zh: 但作为回应，苏兹伯格表示总统对会议进行了歪曲。

sentences.en: In reality, he said, he had told Trump that the phrase fake news was untrue and harmful,
sentences.zh: 他表示，事实上，他曾告诉特朗普，假新闻的说法是不真实的、有害的，

sentences.en: and that the language the president is using to describe the media, including the phrase enemy of the people, could lead to violence against journalists.
sentences.zh: 而且总统用来形容媒体的言论，包括人民的敌人这一说法，可能会导致针对记者的暴力行为。

sentences.en: I warned that it was putting lives at risk, Sulzberger said, that it was undermining the democratic ideals of our nation,
sentences.zh: 苏兹伯格说，我警告过这会危及生命，这会破坏我们国家的民主理想，

sentences.en: and that it was eroding one of our country's greatest exports, a commitment to free speech, and a free press.
sentences.zh: 并且这正在侵蚀我们国家最伟大的出口品之一，即对言论自由和新闻自由的承诺。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格（Sarah Koenig）将为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台上收听。
